anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, broad convex curve with a high radius fitting the boundary from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak projection with a thick pixel base and rounded distal tip, measuring approximately 15% of the visible cranial horizontal axis.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse concave inflection point clearly visible at the pixel junction where the melon’s descending slope meets the horizontal rostrum plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple sets of parallel, linear hypopigmented rake marks; most prominent is a vertical set of four parallel lines on the mid-lateral flank and a diagonal set on the lateral melon.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible blowhole orifice on the dorsal-cranial surface; high-contrast caustic light refraction patterns across the dermal surface.
